answer: A falcon circling a wharf sees every gull that lands twice, and an agent economy can borrow that eye. Anchor identity to a hardware-backed vault: each operator holds one attestation key inside a secure enclave, and the protocol only accepts a second account from the same vault after it has paid a full stake and cleared a cooling-off period. Sybil farmers can mint keys, but they cannot mint enclaves cheaply, so the marginal cost of each fake identity climbs instead of collapsing.
